content: kambo Yeesu tokum kero weni, ceri kange nob bwangka cebo cin yaken cu'nga cunnukur kidiron, fiye fotewiyeu cindo kenwi ci kange nob bwangka cebo.
naweu Yafuda niwo a nekoncotiyeu, nyumom fiyeco, wori Yeesu ki bow nyowi kange nob bwangke cebo.
la Yafuda, tinobda keboni kaba kange durem cimbo kanye fiye liya wabe ni kange farisawa, cin ki kira wenka kange kulen kiyaned.
kambo Yeesu nyimom digero yaken dorcereuri, ciro kab meci, “we ko dotiye?”
cin ciya co “Yeesu bwe najanret.” Yeesu yicii, Inmo.” Yafuda niwo neken cen tim kange no dakebo.
kambo ciyi cii ki” inmo,” ciin yilanken bwii ciin yarken bitine,
yilam meten ci tak, “we kom dotiye?” cin ciyaco Yeesu bwe najaret?”
Yeesu ciya ci, min yikom inmo. non mo citiyeri, kom dob birombo a yakenti.”
wonadim kero citokeu. “mor nubo mwa neyereu, winwo lebo.”
Simon Bitrus niwo ki kulenneu, coku kwalum tuwo cacci yere wo bibwetomange nii wabe. den bwetomange co markus.
Yeesu inyi Bitrus, dokken kulendo morloco. mani ma no kweelmunge tee neyeretiya?”
dila nob dakebo kange duciro kange nob dirlor Yafudawa ko tam Yeesu, ciin bwamco.
ciin yakico kikaba Annas nen tee kon Kayafas nii wabe durko choroceu.
Kayafas coni ne Yafudawa yuiande ki ladiker nii win abuyam kange nubo kilanyeu.
Simon Bitrus bwangtang Yeesu, nyo kange nii bwangka mane. nii bwangka kowa nyumom dur webebo, doken kange co mor luwece.
dila Bitrus tim nyilo kalek. dila nii bwangka ko nyimom liya wabe durken coru'u kale tokker kange nawiye to nyilok tiyen la dubom Bitrus dom mor.
dila nawiye to yilok kotiyeu yi Bitrus, mumani mor nob bwangka niwo ka?” yiki, kebo mo.”
naweu can nyabo kange nubo to lowabe tiyeu tirannyumwi, ci cukirati, wari cweto wi Bitrus tim wari kangeci cukirati.
dur lowabero me Yeesu nob bwangka cebo kange merangka ceko

Yeesu ciyaco minyi dorbitinero kero nyanglang. kwati bak mi ma merangketi mor bikur kwamar fiye Yafudawa mwerumti gwammeu matokbo diger yurangum yurange. ye bwi mu meryere? ye bwi mu merere? me birombo nuwa dige mi tokeu. nubo nubo wuro nyumom dige mitokeu.”
kambo Yeesu tok weri, kange mor nobdirlob tim wi cwuwa Yeesu in yiki, mu ciya durwebero ninti nyo.”
Yeesu in ciyaco toki, “nomatok kero bwirdi yiye tano kebo naki yanecer, yebwe mwa cuwatiye?
la Hananiya tungen Yeesu Kayafa nin niwabe dur.
Simon Bitrus tim we cukirati. nubo meco, “mu mani mor nob kwangka ceba? wengkangum ki, kebo mo.”
win mor canga ni wabe, inke wiwo ci cwalum tuwo, yiki, mi to nenbo kange co mor foti?
Bitrus wengkangum tak, dangjang bicakeu mob. kiyyangeu.
la cin yaken ki Yeesu karak lirya ko durko. kin kwomce, ciki dorcer cidobe karak lirya ko durkonin, wori ci cwibo ci fwe ki caka kwaka ciko.
la Bilatu ceru'u bom meci kom bou ciko dor niwore?”
“cin ciya ciki,” cano nii wo mani ma dige bwira bwiratiri, diger mani a dok yoti nya bouti ki kiyange ce munene.”
Bilatu yicii, kom yanken kico kibwikom ko warco nawo. warka kume tokeu.” dila Yafudawa yico, nyi man ki bikwan nyin warni nin bolang.”
citok wuro nadim kero Yeesu tokeu, wuro dang dorabuwa wo ca matinyeu.
la Bilatus yilam doken karak cou Yeesu yico ki, liya Yafudawa?”
wontok mwek kaka'a kannyemnob yinen ker miro?
Bilatus ciya coki mi kebo “Bayafudeka?” innubo lomwe kange liya wabe cibou ki nen, “ye mu mane?”
Yeesu yico, “liyar miro kebo na dorbitineroce. liyar miro na dorbitineroceri, nob bwangka miko kin tekwen katiyolo cinekenye kang Yafudawa liyar miro kebo fo”
Bilatus yico ki “wendi mun liya ka?” Yeesu ciya, nawo mutokeu min liya. wonco dige bwi cii boyere, wonco dige bwi midou dorbitinereu, ci cuwa tuti ker miro nin.
kambo cito kweri, Bilatus meco, “kerbilengkeryer?” yilam cerin ya Yafudawa nin yici, mifeyabo niwo ki bwirangke.
kom wiki fulendo wo yiki, a womkan nii win nin ki kwama wo kom can kwaka yabkakotiyeu, wekom cwiti nyamka cinene liya Yafudawa ka?”
ciin kundiro kibikwan cin toki, “kebo niwo, Barnabas” in ni kuye.
